Recently, I picked up a pair of Polk audio monitor 10a speakers. I got them for $20, and while they're a little rough around the edges every other part of them appears to be in great shape.

However, I have absolutely nothing to drive them with. I have a very low budget, and I can't find much for sale around here. Anything online is above my price range, and there doesn't seem to be a good selection where I am.

I'm hoping to get ~60wpc RMS. A built in DAC would be very useful but is not required. I don't mind buying vintage or used at all. Rackmount options would be fantastic, although it's not a requirement. My budget is ~$100, though I can go over that a little.

Thanks in advance for any and all help.
I need some help finding an amp

I'm sorry I didn't comment earlier. There are quite a few options available.

For the spartan, try a Lepai 2020A with a higher current power supply. It will easily power your polks and give you a direct 1.8 plug in and RCA for standard components.

If you are willing to spend a little more, try the Amp100 from Audiosource. I love it's simple design and lack of lights. I like to listen to music in a darker room. The Amp100 has only one light.

If you want a remote, check out the Yamaha Natural Sound amplifiers like teh Yamaha R-S201BL 2-Channel Stereo Receiver. Simple design, and inexpensive. You should be able to go to your local Best Buy, show them the Amazon ad, and they will price match.
